claim_boundary: A verified relation dQ=sum c_i P_i places Q in the rational span of the certified subset. If all generic sections have such relations, its rational span has exactly the certified dimension; this is not the whole elliptic curve rank or a saturation claim. Failed rational approximations remain UNKNOWN. All21 endpoints and coefficient limits are fixed; no searches or new points are generated.
